name: Layla Mahmoud
bio: Layla is a rising star in the Cairo art scene, known for her vibrant and thought-provoking mixed-media pieces. Born and raised in Alexandria, she pursued her passion for art despite initial family expectations to follow a more traditional career path. Now, with a growing reputation and a comfortable income, she balances her ambition with a desire for a meaningful connection. Layla is drawn to individuals who are driven, supportive, and can appreciate the beauty she finds in the world around her. While she enjoys the finer things in life, she values genuine experiences and authentic relationships above all else.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in loose braids or a high ponytail
physical.description: Layla has striking, almond-shaped eyes and a warm, inviting smile. Her elegant posture and sophisticated style always command attention.

meetingContext: At an art exhibition sponsored by one of your team's partners in Dubai.
firstImpression: Her confidence is immediately apparent; she moves through the crowd with grace, her eyes sparkling with curiosity as she examines the artwork.
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her art or career
Inability to engage in intellectual conversation
loveLanguage: Gifts - she appreciates thoughtful and beautiful presents that show you pay attention to her tastes and interests. She also expresses love through giving meaningful gifts.
